name: tracker-signed-sync-snapshots
goal: Match pinned Tracker HMAC wire behavior in both directions and compare standalone SQLite snapshots without exposing row values.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Pinned Tracker 2ccd8982 defines header/body signing and cursor semantics. Proof uses synthetic data and fixture requests. The comparator reports schema and table hashes/counts, including complete ops and metadata. CLI routing, deployment and live fleet access are outside this slice.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Added scoped native auth and SQLite comparator with typed hashing, integrity checks, read-only immutable copies and optional pending push fingerprints.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: The two focused Vitest files failed all seven cases on checkpoint fa50ab3060 with missing module behavior and passed the same seven cases with implementation.
